property_mix.era: mixed Victorian through post-war, with modern infill
property_mix.notable: Large university student housing demand drives HMO conversions. Many period properties with original Victorian and Edwardian door furniture.

locksmith_relevant: University student rentals generate high demand for emergency access and master-key systems across Woodhouse and nearby areas.
Victorian and Edwardian terraces in Thorpe Acre and Quorn often retain period locks requiring specialist knowledge and heritage-compliant repair.
Rapid post-war suburban growth means mixed lock ages; locksmiths must handle both sash-window catches and modern cylinder standards.
